senses.gloss:
गय गय,
 I. m.
 1. The name of a Ṛṣi, Rām. 2, 107, 11.
 2. pl. The name of a people, MBh. 2, 1827.
 3. The name of a mountain, MBh. 3, 8304.
 II. f. या.
 1. The name of a river, MBh. 3, 8075.
 2. The name of a river, MBh. 1, 7818.
गाय गाय, i. e. गै + अ, n. A song, Yājñ. 3, 112. In उत्तम-, adj. Bhāg. P. 3, 12, 21, and उरु-, adj. 2, 3, 20, perhaps गा + अ, Walking, or praise.
गायक गायक, i. e. गै + अक, m. A singer, Rām. 2, 65, 2.

गायत्र गायत्र, i. e. गै + अत्र,
 I. m. and n. A song (ved.).
 II. f. त्री.
 1. A certain metre, MBh. 6, 172.
 2. A sacred verse from the Vedas: this is usually personified and considered as a goddess, MBh. 3, 13432.
गायत्रिन् गायत्रिन्, i. e. गायत्र + इन्, m. A singer, MBh. 12, 10352.

गायन गायन, i. e. गै + अन,
 I. m. A public singer, Man. 4, 210.
 II. n. A song, Bhāg. P. 7, 9, 43.
